newsitem.title: USA: Goody's chairman cuts stake to 57 pct.
newsitem.headline: Goody's chairman cuts stake to 57 pct.

text.p: Robert Goodfriend, chairman and chief executive officer of Goody's Family Clothing Inc, said Monday he reduced his stake in the company to 57 percent, or 9,189,605 common shares.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Goodfriend said he sold 215,850 shares of Goody's between October 21 and December 5 at prices ranging from $13.50 to $17.44 a share.
In October, Goodfriend said he held a 58 percent stake in Goody's, a Knoxville, Tenn., clothing retailer with 203 stores in 14 states.
